transformers.js 3.8.1 (Hugging Face), Apache License 2.0 — https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js
Includes the ONNX Runtime Web WebAssembly build (MIT, Microsoft).
Model in /models/whisper-base: onnx-community/whisper-base (OpenAI Whisper, MIT), quantized.
Used on "Write a day" to turn voice messages into text, on the device. Audio never leaves the browser.
